718:t_2:53.en:
$$バナージ$$
「That is what fills her heart with sorrow...」

718:t_2:54.en:
$$サクリファイ$$
「We are not gods... But little by little, what we did turned into an act steeped in the arrogance of a god.」

718:t_2:55.en:
$$サクリファイ$$
「Among the four $$御使い$$s, $$喜びのアドヴェント$$, who held the leading position, managed the universe in joy.」

718:t_2:56.en:
$$甲児$$
「So you're saying that guy was the leader of the $$御使い$$s...」

718:t_2:57.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Then what is a god? Who is this supreme god you serve?」

718:t_2:58.en:
$$サクリファイ$$
「$$至高神ソル$$... It is a new sun that we created...」

718:t_2:59.en:
$$サクリファイ$$
「120 million years ago, it was a system to control the $$オリジン・ロー$$ that transformed us into $$御使い$$s...」

718:t_2:60.en:
$$キリコ$$
「A system... In other words, an artificial god...」

718:t_2:61.en:
$$サクリファイ$$
「It answers the wishes of the $$御使い$$s and produces limitless $$オリジン・ロー$$...」

718:t_2:62.en:
$$サクリファイ$$
「But the will that came to dwell within it ended up denying its own acts... everything the $$御使い$$s had done.」

718:t_2:64.en:
$$サクリファイ$$
「In human terms, it took its own life.」

718:t_2:66.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「You mean it couldn't bear the pangs of conscience.」

718:t_2:67.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「A will that dwelt in matter... It is probably the result of that evolving and gaining a definite power.」

718:t_2:68.en:
$$サクリファイ$$
「That happened 12,000 years ago.」

718:t_2:69.en:
$$サクリファイ$$
「$$至高神ソル$$ shattered into the twelve $$スフィア$$ and countless $$黒の英知$$, and was scattered across various parallel worlds.」

718:t_2:70.en:
$$サクリファイ$$
「Losing $$ソル$$ was a shock to us, but it did not become a problem right away.」

718:t_2:71.en:
$$サクリファイ$$
「Because by then, we had undergone $$シンカ$$ to the utmost, and even without the power of $$ソル$$ we had no trouble managing the universe.」

718:t_2:72.en:
$$サクリファイ$$
「But we learned that to get through the universe's great collapse, which comes once every 120 million years, we would need that existence.」

718:t_2:73.en:
$$アポロ$$
「Couldn't you repair that system called $$ソル$$ or whatever?」

718:t_2:74.en:
$$サクリファイ$$
「$$ソル$$ was the crystallization of our wisdom, and once the factors that make it up were lost, nothing could be done.」

718:t_2:75.en:
$$トライア$$
「And those factors are the $$スフィア$$, right?」

718:t_2:77.en:
$n
「The $$スフィア$$ are... fragments of the $$御使い$$s' god...」

718:t_2:78.en:
$$クロウ$$
「So the $$太極$$ that $$アイム#pilot$$ talked about is that $$至高神ソル$$...」

718:t_2:79.en:
$$サクリファイ$$
「We sought the $$スフィア$$ scattered across all the universes, and the Reactors that draw out their power.」

718:t_2:80.en:
$$サクリファイ$$
「At the same time, we reflected on our own conduct and banished $$喜びのアドヴェント$$, who had held the leading position in it.」

718:t_2:81.en:
$n
「$$アドヴェント#pilot$$ is someone who was banished from the $$御使い$$s...」

718:t_2:82.en:
$$アマタ$$
「During the $$時獄戦役$$, Supreme Commander $$不動$$ called him the last one...」

718:t_2:83.en:
$$桂$$
「So those words were pointing to this.」

718:t_2:84.en:
$$万丈$$
「Why did you not hand down a more decisive punishment to him?」

718:t_2:85.en:
$$サクリファイ$$
「120 million years ago, we touched the truth and cast off conflict completely.」

718:t_2:86.en:
$$サクリファイ$$
「You may not be able to understand this, but taking the lives of our own kind is simply unthinkable.」

718:t_2:87.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「You've taken the lives of countless species out of a warped sense of mission, and you dare say that...」

718:t_2:88.en:
$$サクリファイ$$
「What he did after that, we have no knowledge of...」

718:t_2:89.en:
$$サクリファイ$$
「And then the remaining $$ドクトリン$$, $$テンプティ$$ and I renewed our resolve and set to our mission, determined to guide the universe in the right direction this time.」

718:t_2:90.en:
$$刹那$$
「And the result is managing our Earth?」

718:t_2:91.en:
$$レド$$
「And you destroyed an entire galaxy right before our eyes!」

718:t_2:92.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「Most likely, such acts have been carried out many times over these 12,000 years as well.」

718:t_2:93.en:
$$アムロ$$
「So in the end, nothing changed.」

718:t_2:94.en:
$$サクリファイ$$
「There was no other way...」

718:t_2:95.en:
$$サクリファイ$$
「$$ドクトリン$$ raged at the species advancing down a warped evolution, $$テンプティ$$ reveled in her own power, and I was lost in sorrow...」

718:t_2:96.en:
$$セツコ$$
「Did you do nothing but grieve?」

718:t_2:97.en:
$$ロラン$$
「You're one of the $$御使い$$s too, aren't you!? Why didn't you stop your comrades!?」

718:t_2:98.en:
$$サクリファイ$$
「...Toward the great collapse that comes once every 120 million years, the universe's distortion was advancing steadily...」

718:t_2:99.en:
$$サクリファイ$$
「To stop that as well, it was necessary to guide life in a better direction.」

718:t_2:100.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Anyway, the universe's great collapse ended because we took out the $$宇宙怪獣$$! We don't need you guys managing us anymore!」

718:t_2:101.en:
$$サクリファイ$$
「The great collapse has not ended yet...」

718:t_2:103.en:
$$ラルク$$
「We should have defeated $$バアル$$ with our own hands!」

718:t_2:104.en:
$$サクリファイ$$
「But it is the truth...」

718:t_2:105.en:
$$サクリファイ$$
「That is why $$ドクトリン$$ is in a hurry to destroy those who undergo a warped evolution... in other words, those who may turn into $$バアル$$.」

718:t_2:106.en:
$$シンジ$$
「The universe's great collapse... hasn't ended...」

718:t_2:107.en:
$$ノノ$$
「No way...! Then what were $$ノノ$$ and everyone fighting for!?」

718:t_2:108.en:
$$サクリファイ$$
「...All I could do within that was protect, at my own discretion, those with the potential for $$シンカ$$.」

718:t_2:109.en:
$$シモン$$
「And you're saying we're the ones who were chosen for that?」

718:t_2:110.en:
$$サクリファイ$$
「Exactly. You were branded with the $$烙印$$ so that you would become a benchmark for your Earth.」

718:t_2:111.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「So we were samples of the entire Earth...」

718:t_2:112.en:
$$サクリファイ$$
「Furthermore, I gave you various trials to spur your $$シンカ$$.」

718:t_2:113.en:
$$ガロード$$
「Is that why you sent us to the $$ＡＤＷ$$!?」

718:t_2:114.en:
$$サクリファイ$$
「The super-dimensional life forms... the creatures you call $$バジュラ$$... It was I who sent them to Earth, too.」

718:t_2:115.en:
$$サクリファイ$$
「Contact with them was also a means of testing you.」

718:t_2:116.en:
$$アルト$$
「You mean the $$フロンティア船団$$ got dragged into that!?」

718:t_2:117.en:
$$ゼウス$$
「And for $$シンカ$$, you sent those with the blood of the beast, mingling of waters and destination of the wind factors to the world of the civilization of fire!」

718:t_2:118.en:
$$サクリファイ$$
「Two worlds born of the spacetime disaster called the $$大時空震動$$... The people who live on the Earths you call the $$ＵＣＷ$$ and the $$ＡＤＷ$$...」

718:t_2:119.en:
$$サクリファイ$$
「Including those found by the versions of me from other worlds, I would build a paradise on the planet you call $$蒼の地球$$... That was the best I could do.」

718:t_2:120.en:
$$宗介$$
「And you wrapped that in the $$時の牢獄$$!」

718:t_2:121.en:
$$かなめ$$
「So that means... in the end it was to stop evolution... and $$シンカ$$ on top of that, wasn't it...」

718:t_2:122.en:
$$サクリファイ$$
「I drew the attention of $$ドクトリン$$ and the others to $$翠の地球$$, and built an eternal paradise on $$蒼の地球$$.」

718:t_2:123.en:
$$サクリファイ$$
「But $$ガドライト・メオンサム$$, whom I sent there as an observer, took actions other than the role I had assigned him.」

718:t_2:124.en:
$n
「$$ガドライト#pilot$$, whose homeland was destroyed by the $$サイデリアル$$... in other words, by the $$御使い$$s... couldn't stand that $$蒼の地球$$, protected by the $$御使い$$s, existed...」

718:t_2:125.en:
$$スズネ$$
「I can understand his feelings now... Even if I can't forgive it...」

718:t_2:126.en:
$$サクリファイ$$
「In the end, you drove off $$ガドライト#pilot$$ and, without knowing my feelings, rejected the eternity of the dimensional cage.」

718:t_2:127.en:
$$サクリファイ$$
「That $$蒼の地球$$ was overrun by the $$サイデリアル$$ is a result you brought upon yourselves.」

718:t_2:128.en:
$$サクリファイ$$
「$$アドヴェント#pilot$$ sending you to the galactic core was probably to make you realize your powerlessness, too.」

718:t_2:130.en:
$$サクリファイ$$
「When I learned of it, I temporarily invited you into the $$カオス・コスモス$$ to teach you the futility of resistance.」

718:t_2:131.en:
$$サクリファイ$$
「I showed you a part of our power, yet it was a surprise that you did not stop resisting...」

718:t_2:132.en:
$$赤木$$
「You're far too self-serving! Forcing your goodwill and mercy on us one-sidedly without knowing anything of our circumstances!」

ソル.evidence: Bare form of 至高神ソル (Supreme God Sol, glossary); the system/sun Sacrifice names; no bare token in the sheet

uncertain: Bare ソル has no token; used $$ソル$$ (names entry, 'Sol'); full 至高神ソル uses its glossary token.
次元の檻 = 'dimensional cage' (matches dlg_2067/2087); dlg_2100_00 Doctrine line says 'dimensional prison' for the same-looking term.
Row 117 compressed to fit 3 lines (dropped 'the' before each factor phrase; settled four-phrase refrain kept).
Row 119: 他の世界からの私 read as 'the versions of me from other worlds'; sentence is a trailing clause continuing row 118.
Row 82/83: 最後の一人 = 'the last one'; 不動総司令 = 'Supreme Commander $$不動$$' as in dlg_2004_03.
Row 71: 真化した verb rendered 'undergone $$シンカ$$'.
Row 110: 指標 = 'benchmark'; row 114 超時空生命体 = 'super-dimensional life forms'.
